name.pt-BR: Cartas sobre o caso do quietismo (II)

description.fr-FR: Suite et fin de la correspondance sur l’affaire du quiétisme, de septembre 1698 à 1703 : lettres de Bossuet à son neveu à Rome, de l’abbé Bossuet à son oncle, lettres des cardinaux et des évêques, jusqu’à la condamnation du livre de Fénelon et ses suites. Édition Lachat (1864), tome XXX.
description.en-US: The continuation and end of the correspondence on the Quietist affair, from September 1698 to 1703: Bossuet’s letters to his nephew in Rome, the abbé Bossuet’s letters to his uncle, letters of cardinals and bishops, down to the condemnation of Fénelon’s book and its aftermath. Lachat edition (1864), volume XXX.
description.pt-BR: Continuação e fim da correspondência sobre o caso do quietismo, de setembro de 1698 a 1703: cartas de Bossuet ao sobrinho em Roma, do abade Bossuet ao tio, cartas de cardeais e bispos, até a condenação do livro de Fénelon e suas consequências. Edição Lachat (1864), tomo XXX.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXX, pages 001-015 (Lettres sur l’affaire du quiétisme, suite). The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
